messages:
yasmin: Quick thought — pilot a pop-up 'Mini Hero' station at next Friday's town hall. 2-minute flow: nominate on card, pick a sticker, get an enamel pin if nominated. low lift, high delight.
ori: Love it. logistics? table, sign, pins, stickers, pens, volunteer coverage.
jamie: Ops can provide table + tablecloth + easel for sign. I'll handle setup/packdown.
yasmin: I can write a 1-line blurb for the agenda and a 2-line slack announcement.
spot-bot: Heads-up: standard physical swag turnaround is 7 business days. Rush (+48h) available for a fee.
ori: Quick budget estimate: 100 enamel pins $260, 200 sticker sheets $45, printed nomination cards $15, signage $20, shipping $40 = ~$380.
finance: Approved under Events Q3 budget. Please attach receipts to the card after purchase.
jamie: Volunteer plan: two 15-min shifts during town hall (pre-doors, mid-break) + 30-min packdown. Who can cover?
yasmin: I can do pre-doors and handle the announcement handoff. also will make a QR code for a digital nomination option.
ori: I'll cover mid-break and manage the sticker/pin distribution. I'll coordinate vendor proof for pins and confirm lead times.
jamie: Can we avoid glitter near AV? please no. :grimacing:
yasmin: noted. also propose a small sign note about accessibility: volunteers can transcribe spoken nominations into the form.
spot-bot: ACTION: submit final pin art by Tue 12:00 for standard production.
yasmin: I'll post mockups and the announcement copy here by Monday morning. also will create a short sign that says: "Mini Hero Nominations — 1-2 sentences about how they helped you".
ori: I'll generate the QR and put it on the sign + back of cards.
jamie: After event: collect 2-3 quick quotes and a photo for social. spot-bot will remind.
finance: Once payment is processed, share the receipt and expense code. thanks!
yasmin: Checklist: pin art & approval (all), place order (ori), print cards + sign (jamie), volunteer signups (yasmin). converting this to a tiny task card now. thanks team! :seedling:
